headline: Lumax Auto Technologies Q2 Net Profit Jumps 50% to Rs 116 Crore
summary: Lumax Auto Technologies reported a 50.44% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 116.67 crore alongside plans for a Rs 150 crore facility in Manesar.
why: Automotive component manufacturers rely on robust vehicle production volumes, making their earnings reports key indicators for the broader automotive sector.

impacts.name: Lumax Auto Technologies
impacts.why: Strong quarterly profit growth and capital expansion into new manufacturing facilities signal healthy operational demand.
